blocks.text: SB19 is set to attend the 2026 Asean Summit closing ceremony where they will perform the event’s official theme song, “Together in Motion.” The P-pop trailblazers, who serve as the country’s tourism ambassadors alongside BINI, will deliver a live performance of their song on Tuesday, Nov. 17, at 5 p.m, as per the announcement made by Tourism Philippines on its social media pages. The performance will also be streamed live on Asean 2026 PH Facebook page.
